So you’re interested in Whiskers, but you have a few questions. Lucky for you, we have answers.

Here’s what cat owners ask us most.
What’s the difference between fresh and tinned?
Lots of tinned food is heavily processed. Ours is gently cooked from real ingredients. You do the maths.

values.altText: A tub of fresh cat food

values.text: How does it help my cat’s digestion?
Gently cooked, high-protein food is easier to digest, so your cat gets more from every meal.
Regular meals are what make the difference. A subscription means food arrives before you run out. Changed your mind? Cancelling is easy.
But will my cat actually eat it?
Most cats love it. We test every recipe for taste, because healthy food only helps if it gets eaten.
